solver: one proposed uniform-thickness periodic FVMSW rotating-wave Galerkin model
physical_accuracy_gate: 8 substeps/token; preflight 32-token final-state difference below 1% versus 64 substeps
numeric_gate: CPU/GPU features and current gradients agree at rtol=0.002, atol=0.00001; finite-difference current gradient test
structure_parameter: input antenna offset in grid cells; design-time variable
selection: full validation split CE, then lower offset for ties; never test
main_test: entire 5% character test split, nonoverlapping 32-character windows; discarded tail reported
checkpoint_selection: lowest validation CE within fixed update budget
generation: 400 new characters, temperature 0.8, fixed seeds, prompt First Citizen followed by newline
checkpoint_and_scalar_storage: node RAM temp; completed-run snapshots streamed to Mac; no per-evaluation statevector storage
energy_claim: none; GPU throughput and magnetic-device energy are distinct
measurement_cost_claim: none; report sensor features and digital readout multiply-add count
